idea-plugin.name: Varro: OpenJet
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode workbench for JetBrains IDEs

Use OpenCode in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, DataGrip and other JetBrains IDEs. Ask questions about your project, plan changes and review AI-generated edits without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Run parallel chat sessions in the tool window, editor tabs or detached IDE windows.
  • Add files, editor selections, terminal output and project errors and warnings as context. In IDEs with Database Tools, attach table schemas and selected rows.
  • Review plans, tool activity and file diffs. Control permissions per session or project.
  • Choose models and agents, view API pricing and provider quotas, and track token usage across projects.
  • Generate commit messages from your Git changes.
  • Connect to OpenCode V1 or V2 with automatic version detection, and import V1 conversations into V2.

Varro OpenJet brings the Varro chat interface from VS Code to the IntelliJ Platform. It uses your existing OpenCode configuration for providers, models, agents, commands, skills and MCP servers.

Requirements

  • A JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or newer with a JCEF-enabled runtime. Detached chat window commands require IDE 2026.1 or newer.
  • OpenCode CLI V2 2.0.5 or newer, or V1 1.16.0 or newer, on PATH or configured in Settings | Tools | Varro. Install V2 with npm install -g @opencode/cli.
  • A configured provider. Run opencode auth login, or use /connect in the chat.

Network and credential disclosure

  • Chat requests go through a local OpenCode server. Varro can discover a registered V2 service, connect on the configured port, or start a server when needed.
  • Provider-limit polling contacts provider quota endpoints directly.
  • Provider-limit polling uses existing provider credentials in the IDE host, including supported OAuth refresh. The webview receives quota counters and statuses, not credentials.
  • Terminal commands the chat can request are restricted to a fixed allowlist of OpenCode authentication, install and upgrade commands.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.8

Synced Varro through a061cf7d4a3e. Added OpenCode V2 session pause and resume, with parked queued messages and pause-aware session and usage durations. Large text pastes become previewable attachments that survive draft and queue restoration. Improved streaming activity, attachment display and scrolling as the composer collapses. V2 commit-message generation uses the stateless endpoint when available, with helper-session fallback for older servers and unsupported models. Updated DOMPurify.

0.3.7

Synced Varro through 45eedb25d62c. Pasted saved-editor selections and matching terminal output become context attachments. Improved attachment editing, queued context and composer completion placement. Model refreshes show progress and discover new models while retaining explicit removals across chat views. V2 synthetic messages appear as automatic-action notices. Authenticated servers now prompt for credentials and save verified passwords in the IDE password safe. Corrected migrated usage timing and retained recycle-bin entries until deletion is confirmed.

0.3.6

Synced the latest Varro UI, fixing scroll position after short replies and showing permission approval failures inline. Aligned attach-only connections with upstream: external servers use the configured port without ownership takeover or local maintenance, usage reports read server history, and unsupported local configuration, quota, CLI and history-import actions explain where to run them.

0.3.5

Updated the Varro chat UI and aligned the OpenCode V2 backend. Background shell work now keeps sessions busy through follow-up turns and stops when cancelled. Queued and steering messages retain their delivery state. Fixed provider sign-in attempt tracking, cancellation cleanup and authentication form defaults and field types. Corrected configured model pricing, partial model limits, project configuration precedence and mixed-format model routing. Fixed workspace paths containing Unicode or literal percent escapes, and hid incomplete HTML tags while Markdown streams.

0.3.4

Added workspace disabling for automatically discovered Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM providers in OpenCode V2. Disabled providers' configured models now stay hidden. Fixed provider credential and environment status using V2 integration data. Updated provider reconnection and retry recovery notices, corrected the provider logout command, and fixed file-edit card cleanup during chat updates.

0.3.3

Added TypeSafe Jev as an optional reviewer for Auto-mode permission requests, connected from the Models view menu and stored in the IDE password safe, or read from TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Jev reviews requests before the judge model and approves only confident, low-risk actions. Everything else asks, and Jev errors fall back to the judge model. Auto-approve activity now shows which model reviewed each request.

0.3.2

Added shared OpenCode server ownership across Varro family products, with ownership handoff and recovery after an IDE host exits. Closing a project now leaves its server available to other Varro hosts. Fixed ownership recovery after macOS binary updates. Restart checks now detect active sessions and pending questions or permissions, while allowing idle V2 servers to restart when historical session directories have been deleted.

0.3.1

Added retry recovery notices to assistant history. Updated V2 installation and upgrade commands, provider authentication forms and server status screens. Fixed handling of streamed message parts, permissions and Windows paths. Provider connection forms now accept optional fields and support multiple conditions for showing a field.

0.3.0

Added OpenCode V2 support from 2.0.5, alongside V1 support from 1.16.0, with automatic protocol detection and discovery of registered local V2 services. Added authenticated V2 connections, V2 configuration support, and CLI updates using the matching package. Added a Tools-menu action to import V1 conversations and their same-workspace child sessions into V2. Usage reports now read both versions and avoid counting imported conversations twice. Updated chat rendering for V2 skill, shell and patch activity. The tool window now shows the connected OpenCode server version.

0.2.0

Removed the upper IDE build limit, with support starting at 2025.2. Detached chat window commands now appear only on IDEs with the required APIs, available in 2026.1 and newer. Added API pricing and provider quota details to the model picker, using cached models.dev rates with OpenCode pricing as a fallback. Permission prompts now identify subagent requests. Older message summaries show relative dates.

0.1.7

Added detached IDE windows for new and existing chats. Added a light/dark toggle in wide editor and window chats, with per-chat state and a saved preference for new chats. Fixed stale browser regions during window resizing. Smoothed bottom following as messages grow and corrected message-row alignment before painting.

0.1.6

Added workspace errors and warnings as chat context, with individual problem references, a Problems-view action and settings to disable inclusion. Problem attachments persist across drafts, queued messages and message edits. Added table attachments from Database Explorer drag-and-drop and @ mentions, and preserved database snapshot details in stored attachments. Reduced redundant editor-context refreshes and saved-view updates. Improved streaming Markdown performance and set a 60 FPS default for off-screen browser rendering, with IDE frame-rate overrides respected. Added an in-IDE scrolling benchmark.

0.1.5

Added database context in DataGrip and IDEs with Database Tools, including table schemas, selected rows and JSON snapshot attachments. Added opt-in sharing of model lists and core settings across JetBrains IDEs. Fixed macOS line navigation in editable chat content.

0.1.4

Added a read-only Ask agent and shell and patch timers. Saved and synced session selections across views. Fixed permission saving, draft selections and session forking. Improved auto-scroll, streaming Markdown and attachment spacing. Refined light-theme styling, compaction visibility and the toolbar version label.

0.1.3

Smoothed streaming text, tool activity transitions and auto-scroll. Reduced scroll jumps when activity, to-do lists and file-change cards collapse. Kept more sessions visible in the session list and fixed formatting for editor and terminal selections containing Markdown code fences.

0.1.2

Refined chat activity and file-change display. Fixed auto-scroll, diff preview stability, streaming inline code, and composer busy indicators. Restored native Command+Arrow navigation.

0.1.1

Fixed browser resource loading and file drag-and-drop on IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2, 2025.3 and 2026.1, and quota requests on 2025.2 with redirects still blocked. Removed internal API dependencies and redundant generated overrides. Verified on IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2.6.3, 2025.3.6.1, 2026.1.5 and 2026.2.2.

0.1.0

Initial release of the OpenCode workbench for JetBrains IDEs, with project-aware chat, parallel sessions, plan and change review, model and permission controls, and usage reporting.
